note: Semantic tool roles used by this packet. runtimeToolId stays null until the earlier field-kit packet is mapped. Puzzles call these roles by name.

tools.use: Measure a posted length, latch a gap, pull along a straight line, couple wheels, bind the seam shut.
Hold a gate, jam a press, bridge a posted gap, turn a gear, plant a path in imagination.
See which door the reflection omits, align two marks, show a wish-state floor.
Find the true vertical among false landings, falls, wax lives, and a stamped plot.
Show gouged names, thaw one ice face, light a stove, reveal overflow ticks.
Cut red tape, a ribbon, a page-thick film, or one corner of a controlled page.
Copy what is already written in the room. The book is how discoveries persist as text. It is not a riddle journal.
Call a posted civic role, still a shore, speak a fiction aloud, ring a distributed seam.
Stamp a warrant, a false charter, or the seam itself. Using it is remembered. It is never required to finish the dungeons.
Point across water or void inside the final quarter only. It is not an overworld quest marker.
Read depth. Marks safe ice, void, and fords. Required together with the needle for embryonic crossing.
The current body's coat. Hung, it is an anchor or a presence. It is not a second character.
